restaurants_logo_pair.name: restaurants_logo_pair
restaurants_logo_pair.value: (logo_base is null) = (logo_widths is null) and (logo_widths is null or cardinality(logo_widths) >= 1)

restaurants_cover_pair.name: restaurants_cover_pair
restaurants_cover_pair.value: (cover_base is null) = (cover_widths is null) and (cover_widths is null or cardinality(cover_widths) >= 1)

items_par_level.name: items_par_level
items_par_level.value: par_level is null or (reorder_point is not null and par_level > reorder_point)

recipes_photo_pair.name: recipes_photo_pair
recipes_photo_pair.value: (photo_base is null) = (photo_widths is null) and (photo_widths is null or cardinality(photo_widths) >= 1)

recipes_menu_only_dish.name: recipes_menu_only_dish
recipes_menu_only_dish.value: kind = 'DISH' or (description is null and menu_section_id is null and menu_position = 0 and photo_base is null and photo_widths is null)

adjustment_requests_other_decider.name: adjustment_requests_other_decider
adjustment_requests_other_decider.value: decided_by is null or decided_by <> created_by or status = 'CANCELLED' or self_decided

adjustment_requests_self_decided.name: adjustment_requests_self_decided
adjustment_requests_self_decided.value: not self_decided or (decided_by = created_by and status in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))

stock_movements_sale_once.name: stock_movements_sale_once
stock_movements_sale_once.where: order_id is not null and reason_id is null

stock_movements_sale_order.name: stock_movements_sale_order
stock_movements_sale_order.value: type::text <> 'SALE_RECIPE' or order_id is not null

stock_movements_order_type.name: stock_movements_order_type
stock_movements_order_type.value: order_id is null or type::text in ('SALE_RECIPE', 'REVERSAL', 'LOSS')

menu_accesses_expiry_by_kind.name: menu_accesses_expiry_by_kind
menu_accesses_expiry_by_kind.value: (kind = 'QR' and expires_at is not null and expires_at = opened_at + interval '20 minutes') or (kind = 'TABLET' and expires_at is null)

orders_source_shape.name: orders_source_shape
orders_source_shape.value: (source::text in ('QR', 'TABLET') and menu_access_id is not null and placed_by is null) or (source = 'STAFF' and menu_access_id is null and placed_by is not null)

orders_cancel_note.name: orders_cancel_note
orders_cancel_note.value: cancel_reason is distinct from 'OTHER' or cancel_note is not null

cash_entries_note.name: cash_entries_note
cash_entries_note.value: reason is distinct from 'OTHER' or note is not null

cash_sessions_opening_note.name: cash_sessions_opening_note
cash_sessions_opening_note.value: previous_kept is null or previous_kept = opening_float or opening_note is not null

cash_sessions_closed.name: cash_sessions_closed
cash_sessions_closed.value: num_nonnulls(closed_at, closed_by, expected, counted, difference, kept, service_charge, closing_count_id) = case when status = 'CLOSED' then 8 else 0 end

cash_sessions_close_note.name: cash_sessions_close_note
cash_sessions_close_note.value: case when status = 'OPEN' then close_note is null else difference = 0 or close_note is not null end

tab_events_user.name: tab_events_user
tab_events_user.value: kind = 'OPENED' or user_id is not null

tab_payments_cash.name: tab_payments_cash
tab_payments_cash.value: case when method = 'CASH' then received is not null and change >= 0 and received = amount + change else received is null and change is null end

table_tabs_closed.name: table_tabs_closed
table_tabs_closed.value: num_nonnulls(closed_at, closed_by, closed_day, subtotal, service_charge, total) = case when status = 'CLOSED' then 6 else 0 end
